topography.project_purpose: Algo-Stables. Structurally: 24 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (contractguard, operator, erc20burnable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
